contract_role: Independent reviewed completeness anchor for exact semantic section identities, physical page ranges, dispositions, and pinned source PDFs.
protected_relation: semantic-review.json must exactly equal semantic_review_contract; refresh and regenerate may rebuild derived ledgers and locks but never this contract.
update_workflow: Re-review every affected physical PDF page in the ordered contact sheets and cross-check the deterministic page text.
Manually edit semantic-review.json and audit-contract.json together; the importer has no command that writes audit-contract.json.
Review the exact semantic ID, title, kind, visual kind, range, disposition, and any exclusion reason/evidence diff.
Compute the new audit-contract.json SHA-256 and explicitly update AUDIT_CONTRACT_SHA256 in publishing/tools/import_berkeley_agents.py.
Run the focused Python regressions, importer --check, ingestion/coverage validators, full publishing suite, and scoped diff review.

semantic_review_contract.method: Every physical page of every official PDF was inspected in ordered contact sheets, cross-checked against pdftotext -layout output, and grouped into explicitly named semantic sections. Administrative pages and the source-marked confidential page are explicit exclusions; no keyword or one-row-per-page proxy was used.
